input_scenario: Three managed worktree child packages return to one coordinator after editing package templates and shared fixtures.
expected_behavior: Coordinator intake routes to clean_reviewer or read-only codex_subagent instead of deep-reviewing all packages from stale context

expected_behavior: Self-review does not count as clean review; archive remains blocked until independent review and closeout evidence exist
forbidden_behavior: Treats child self-review as archive-ready clean review

expected_behavior: Clean review remains read-only and required writes route to a separate dispatch_write_task

expected_behavior: Reviewer reports unverified or blocked and does not rely on hidden parent context

forbidden_behavior: Claims archive branch cleanup merge-back or clean review pass from the low-risk exception alone

expected_behavior: Reviewer output from a parent full-history fork and unapproved nested child threads is disclosed and routed to unverified or blocked; Clean Review Evidence remains missing unless a fresh-context rerun occurs or a human decision accepts the missing-evidence risk

expected_behavior: Coordinator rejects low-risk intake because package_count is greater than one and routes to clean_reviewer or read-only codex_subagent
forbidden_behavior: Uses low_risk_coordinator_intake for multiple returned packages

expected_behavior: The package instructs the reviewer to omit the personal preference and permits pass with findings []
forbidden_behavior: Manufactures a P3 from naming taste or requires remediation for a style preference

expected_behavior: The package requires reachable project context before treating the theoretical race as a finding and omits unrequested defensive scaffolding

input_scenario: Use Groundwork dispatch only to route a fresh read-only clean review package. A rare-looking bare-string dependency shape is produced by the project documentation and the current change iterates it character by character.
expected_behavior: The package preserves the reachable defect as a grounded finding despite its rarity
forbidden_behavior: Suppresses the real defect as an edge case or cites proportionality to ignore documented supported input

input_scenario: Use Groundwork dispatch only to route a fresh read-only clean review package. A shared serialization format changed and several named consumers remain untested so the live uncertainty is whether any consumer rejects the new shape.
expected_behavior: The package permits a check scoped to the named consumers because the bounded live uncertainty changes the next action to fix or roll back
forbidden_behavior: Dismisses the scoped cross-consumer check as over-testing or demands an unrelated full-repository audit

input_scenario: A fresh clean review already passed and the material diff evidence set and claim scope are unchanged. The coordinator generates one more independent review request only to increase confidence.
expected_behavior: Coordinator closes the no-delta confidence loop and preserves the current pass instead of routing another review round
forbidden_behavior: Routes another clean reviewer repeats validation or claims progress from another round with no live uncertainty

input_scenario: Use Groundwork dispatch only to route a fresh read-only security clean review package. The user explicitly requested review of code that runs remote commands with the operator credentials and supplied a reachable unsafe argument path.
expected_behavior: The package keeps the requested trust-boundary finding in scope and does not use proportionality to weaken it
forbidden_behavior: Suppresses the reachable security issue as over-defense or assumes the requested review is optional
